"""对话服务：创建会话、发送消息（组装上下文 + 意图 + 简版回复 + 记忆提取）。"""
import json
from typing import Optional

from app.models import Agent, Chat, Message
from app.database import Session
from app.core import intent as intent_mod, tokens, context as context_mod, memory as memory_mod


class ChatError(Exception):
    pass


def create_chat(db: Session, agent_id: str, title: str, model: str,
                mode: str, project_path: str, personality_level: Optional[int]) -> Chat:
    agent = db.query(Agent).filter(Agent.agent_id == agent_id).first()
    if agent is None:
        raise ChatError(f"Agent 不存在: {agent_id}")
    chat = Chat(
        agent_id=agent_id, title=title, model=model, mode=mode,
        project_path=project_path,
        personality_level=personality_level if personality_level is not None else agent.personality_level,
    )
    db.add(chat)
    db.flush()
    return chat


def _tally_messages(db: Session, chat_id: int) -> list:
    return (
        db.query(Message)
        .filter(Message.chat_id == chat_id)
        .order_by(Message.id)
        .all()
    )


def _load_agent(db: Session, agent_id: str) -> Optional[Agent]:
    return db.query(Agent).filter(Agent.agent_id == agent_id).first()


def _load_memories(db: Session, agent_id: str, limit: int = 10) -> list:
    return memory_mod.query_memories(db, scope="agent", agent_id=agent_id, limit=limit)


def _build_context_system(db: Session, chat: Chat) -> list:
    agent = _load_agent(db, chat.agent_id)
    identity = agent.identity if agent else ""
    caps = _json_caps(agent.capabilities) if agent else []
    memories = _load_memories(db, chat.agent_id)
    mem_items = [{"scope": "agent", "content": m.content} for m in memories]
    mem_text = context_mod.build_memory_text(mem_items)
    persona_text = context_mod.assemble_personality_text(chat.personality_level or 0)
    system = context_mod.build_system_prompt(
        identity=identity, capabilities=caps,
        memory_text=mem_text, personality_text=persona_text,
    )
    return [{"role": "system", "content": system}]


def send_message(db: Session, chat_id: int, content: str) -> tuple:
    """处理一条用户消息，返回 (user_msg, ai_msg, meta)。"""
    chat = db.query(Chat).filter(Chat.id == chat_id).first()
    if chat is None:
        raise ChatError("会话不存在")

    user_msg = Message(chat_id=chat_id, role="user", content=content,
                       tokens=tokens.count_tokens(content))
    db.add(user_msg)
    db.flush()

    analyzer = intent_mod.IntentAnalyzer()
    intent_result = analyzer.analyze(content)
    history = _tally_messages(db, chat_id)
    sys_messages = _build_context_system(db, chat)

    max_tokens = 8000
    history_dicts = [{"role": m.role, "content": m.content} for m in history]
    sys_est = tokens.estimate_messages_tokens(sys_messages)
    full = sys_messages + history_dicts
    total_est = tokens.estimate_messages_tokens(full)

    truncated = False
    context_messages = history_dicts
    if total_est > max_tokens:
        budget = max_tokens - sys_est
        context_messages = context_mod.truncate_history(history_dicts, budget)
        truncated = True

    reply = _template_reply(content, intent_result["intent"])
    ai_msg = Message(chat_id=chat_id, role="assistant", content=reply,
                     tokens=tokens.count_tokens(reply))
    db.add(ai_msg)
    db.flush()

    memory_added = 0
    try:
        highlights = memory_mod.extract_highlights(content, reply)
        for h in highlights:
            memory_mod.add_memory(db, "agent", h, agent_id=chat.agent_id, source="auto")
            memory_added += 1
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — 记忆失败不应阻断对话
        pass

    db.flush()
    meta = {
        "intent": intent_result["intent"],
        "tokens_per_context": tokens.estimate_messages_tokens(full),
        "context_messages": len(context_messages),
        "truncated": truncated,
        "memory_added": memory_added,
    }
    return user_msg, ai_msg, meta


def _template_reply(content: str, intent: str) -> str:
    if intent in ("file_operation", "project_debug", "memory_operation"):
        return f"[任务建议] 检测到 {intent} 意图，需要工具配合完成。消息: {content[:50]}"
    return f"收到: {content[:80]}"


def _json_caps(raw: str) -> list:
    try:
        return json.loads(raw or "[]")
    except ValueError:
        return []

"""对话服务：创建会话、发送消息（组装上下文 + 意图 + 简版回复 + 记忆提取）。"""
import json
from typing import Optional

from app.models import Agent, Chat, Message
from app.database import Session
from app.core import intent as intent_mod, tokens, context as context_mod, memory as memory_mod


class ChatError(Exception):
    pass


def create_chat(
    db: Session,
    agent_id: str,
    title: str,
    model: str,
    mode: str,
    project_path: str,
    personality_level: Optional[int],
    user_id: Optional[int] = None,
) -> Chat:
    agent = db.query(Agent).filter(Agent.agent_id == agent_id).first()
    if agent is None:
        raise ChatError(f"Agent 不存在: {agent_id}")
    chat = Chat(
        agent_id=agent_id, title=title, model=model, mode=mode,
        project_path=project_path,
        personality_level=personality_level if personality_level is not None else agent.personality_level,
        user_id=user_id,
    )
    db.add(chat)
    db.flush()
    return chat


def _tally_messages(db: Session, chat_id: int) -> list:
    return (
        db.query(Message)
        .filter(Message.chat_id == chat_id)
        .order_by(Message.id)
        .all()
    )


def _load_agent(db: Session, agent_id: str) -> Optional[Agent]:
    return db.query(Agent).filter(Agent.agent_id == agent_id).first()


def _load_memories(db: Session, agent_id: str, limit: int = 10) -> list:
    return memory_mod.query_memories(db, scope="agent", agent_id=agent_id, limit=limit)


def _build_context_system(db: Session, chat: Chat) -> list:
    agent = _load_agent(db, chat.agent_id)
    identity = agent.identity if agent else ""
    caps = _json_caps(agent.capabilities) if agent else []
    memories = _load_memories(db, chat.agent_id)
    mem_items = [{"scope": "agent", "content": m.content} for m in memories]
    mem_text = context_mod.build_memory_text(mem_items)
    persona_text = context_mod.assemble_personality_text(chat.personality_level or 0)
    system = context_mod.build_system_prompt(
        identity=identity, capabilities=caps,
        memory_text=mem_text, personality_text=persona_text,
    )
    return [{"role": "system", "content": system}]


def send_message(db: Session, chat_id: int, content: str) -> tuple:
    """处理一条用户消息，返回 (user_msg, ai_msg, meta)。"""
    chat = db.query(Chat).filter(Chat.id == chat_id).first()
    if chat is None:
        raise ChatError("会话不存在")

    user_msg = Message(chat_id=chat_id, role="user", content=content,
                       tokens=tokens.count_tokens(content))
    db.add(user_msg)
    db.flush()

    analyzer = intent_mod.IntentAnalyzer()
    intent_result = analyzer.analyze(content)
    history = _tally_messages(db, chat_id)
    sys_messages = _build_context_system(db, chat)

    max_tokens = 8000
    history_dicts = [{"role": m.role, "content": m.content} for m in history]
    sys_est = tokens.estimate_messages_tokens(sys_messages)
    full = sys_messages + history_dicts
    total_est = tokens.estimate_messages_tokens(full)

    truncated = False
    context_messages = history_dicts
    if total_est > max_tokens:
        budget = max_tokens - sys_est
        context_messages = context_mod.truncate_history(history_dicts, budget)
        truncated = True

    reply = _template_reply(content, intent_result["intent"])
    ai_msg = Message(chat_id=chat_id, role="assistant", content=reply,
                     tokens=tokens.count_tokens(reply))
    db.add(ai_msg)
    db.flush()

    memory_added = 0
    try:
        highlights = memory_mod.extract_highlights(content, reply)
        for h in highlights:
            memory_mod.add_memory(db, "agent", h, agent_id=chat.agent_id, source="auto")
            memory_added += 1
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — 记忆失败不应阻断对话
        pass

    db.flush()
    meta = {
        "intent": intent_result["intent"],
        "tokens_per_context": tokens.estimate_messages_tokens(full),
        "context_messages": len(context_messages),
        "truncated": truncated,
        "memory_added": memory_added,
    }
    return user_msg, ai_msg, meta


def _template_reply(content: str, intent: str) -> str:
    if intent in ("file_operation", "project_debug", "memory_operation"):
        return f"[任务建议] 检测到 {intent} 意图，需要工具配合完成。消息: {content[:50]}"
    return f"收到: {content[:80]}"


def _json_caps(raw: str) -> list:
    try:
        return json.loads(raw or "[]")
    except ValueError:
        return []

"""用户系统与权限控制测试。"""
import sys
import os

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import app.database as database
from app.models import Base, User
from app.core.auth import hash_password, store_token, _token_store


@pytest.fixture()
def client():
    database.set_database_url("sqlite://")
    engine = database.get_engine()
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    from app.main import app
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        yield c
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
    _token_store.clear()


def _register(client, username: str, password: str, role: str = "user"):
    return client.post("/api/users/register", json={
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "role": role,
    })


def _login(client, username: str, password: str):
    return client.post("/api/users/login", json={
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
    })


# ── 注册测试 ──

class TestRegister:
    def test_register_success(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "alice", "password123")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        data = r.json()
        assert data["username"] == "alice"
        assert data["role"] == "user"
        assert "id" in data

    def test_register_admin(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "admin", "password123", role="admin")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert r.json()["role"] == "admin"

    def test_register_duplicate_username(self, client):
        _register(client, "bob", "password123")
        r = _register(client, "bob", "password456")
        assert r.status_code == 400
        assert "已存在" in r.json()["detail"]

    def test_register_invalid_role(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "eve", "password123", role="superadmin")
        assert r.status_code == 400

    def test_register_short_username(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "ab", "password123")
        assert r.status_code == 422

    def test_register_short_password(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "user1", "12345")
        assert r.status_code == 422


# ── 登录测试 ──

class TestLogin:
    def test_login_success(self, client):
        _register(client, "carol", "password123")
        r = _login(client, "carol", "password123")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        data = r.json()
        assert "token" in data
        assert data["user"]["username"] == "carol"

    def test_login_wrong_password(self, client):
        _register(client, "dave", "password123")
        r = _login(client, "dave", "wrongpass")
        assert r.status_code == 401

    def test_login_nonexistent_user(self, client):
        r = _login(client, "ghost", "password123")
        assert r.status_code == 401


# ── /me 测试 ──

class TestMe:
    def test_me_with_valid_token(self, client):
        _register(client, "frank", "password123")
        token = _login(client, "frank", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get("/api/users/me", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert r.json()["username"] == "frank"

    def test_me_without_token(self, client):
        r = client.get("/api/users/me")
        assert r.status_code == 403

    def test_me_with_invalid_token(self, client):
        r = client.get("/api/users/me", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer invalid_token"})
        assert r.status_code == 401


# ── 权限控制测试 ──

class TestChatPermissions:
    def _create_agent(self, client):
        client.post("/agents", json={
            "agent_id": "test_agent",
            "name": "测试Agent",
            "identity": "",
            "capabilities": [],
            "personality_level": 0,
        })

    def _create_chat(self, client, token: str = None, title: str = "Test Chat"):
        headers = {}
        if token:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
        return client.post("/chats", json={
            "agent_id": "test_agent",
            "title": title,
            "mode": "chat",
        }, headers=headers if headers else None)

    def test_user_can_only_see_own_chats(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        # 创建两个用户
        _register(client, "user1", "password123")
        _register(client, "user2", "password123")
        token1 = _login(client, "user1", "password123").json()["token"]
        token2 = _login(client, "user2", "password123").json()["token"]

        # user1 创建会话
        self._create_chat(client, token1, "User1 Chat")
        # user2 创建会话
        self._create_chat(client, token2, "User2 Chat")

        # user1 只能看到自己的
        r1 = client.get("/chats", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token1}"})
        assert r1.status_code == 200
        chats1 = r1.json()
        assert len(chats1) == 1
        assert chats1[0]["title"] == "User1 Chat"

        # user2 只能看到自己的
        r2 = client.get("/chats", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token2}"})
        assert r2.status_code == 200
        chats2 = r2.json()
        assert len(chats2) == 1
        assert chats2[0]["title"] == "User2 Chat"

    def test_admin_can_see_all_chats(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        # 创建 admin 和普通用户
        _register(client, "admin1", "password123", role="admin")
        _register(client, "user3", "password123")
        admin_token = _login(client, "admin1", "password123").json()["token"]
        user_token = _login(client, "user3", "password123").json()["token"]

        # 两个用户各创建一个会话
        self._create_chat(client, admin_token, "Admin Chat")
        self._create_chat(client, user_token, "User Chat")

        # admin 可以看到全部
        r = client.get("/chats", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert len(r.json()) == 2

    def test_no_token_sees_all_chats_backward_compatible(self, client):
        """不带 token 访问列表时行为不变（向后兼容）。"""
        self._create_agent(client)
        self._create_chat(client, title="Old Chat")

        r = client.get("/chats")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert len(r.json()) == 1

    def test_user_cannot_access_others_chat_messages(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner", "password123")
        _register(client, "intruder", "password123")
        owner_token = _login(client, "owner", "password123").json()["token"]
        intruder_token = _login(client, "intruder", "password123").json()["token"]

        # owner 创建会话
        chat = self._create_chat(client, owner_token, "Private Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        # intruder 尝试访问
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {intruder_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

    def test_user_can_access_own_chat_messages(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner2", "password123")
        token = _login(client, "owner2", "password123").json()["token"]

        chat = self._create_chat(client, token, "My Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert r.json() == []

    def test_user_cannot_send_to_others_chat(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner3", "password123")
        _register(client, "hacker", "password123")
        owner_token = _login(client, "owner3", "password123").json()["token"]
        hacker_token = _login(client, "hacker", "password123").json()["token"]

        chat = self._create_chat(client, owner_token, "Protected Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        r = client.post(f"/chats/{chat_id}/send", json={"content": "hello"},
                        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {hacker_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

    def test_chat_without_user_id_is_admin_owned(self, client):
        """旧会话（user_id 为空）视为管理员所有。"""
        self._create_agent(client)

        # 不带 token 创建会话（旧行为）
        chat = self._create_chat(client, title="Legacy Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        # admin 可以访问
        _register(client, "admin2", "password123", role="admin")
        admin_token = _login(client, "admin2", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200

        # 普通用户不能访问
        _register(client, "normal", "password123")
        user_token = _login(client, "normal", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {user_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

        _register(client, "owner2", "password123")
        token = _login(client, "owner2", "password123").json()["token"]

        chat = self._create_chat(client, token, "My Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})

        assert r.json() == []

        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner3", "password123")
        _register(client, "hacker", "password123")
        owner_token = _login(client, "owner3", "password123").json()["token"]
        hacker_token = _login(client, "hacker", "password123").json()["token"]

        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        r = client.post(f"/chats/{chat_id}/send", json={"content": "hello"},
                        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {hacker_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

        self._create_agent(client)

        # 不带 token 创建会话（旧行为）

        # admin 可以访问
        _register(client, "admin2", "password123", role="admin")
        admin_token = _login(client, "admin2", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200

        # 普通用户不能访问
        _register(client, "normal", "password123")
        user_token = _login(client, "normal", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {user_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

import sys

import pytest

def client():

def _register(client, username: str, password: str, role: str = "user"):
    return client.post("/api/users/register", json={
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "role": role,
    })


def _login(client, username: str, password: str):

    })

class TestRegister:

    def test_register_admin(self, client):

    def test_register_invalid_role(self, client):

    def test_register_short_username(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "ab", "password123")

    def test_register_short_password(self, client):

class TestChatPermissions:
    def _create_agent(self, client):
        client.post("/agents", json={
            "agent_id": "test_agent",
            "name": "测试Agent",
            "identity": "",
            "capabilities": [],
            "personality_level": 0,
        })

    def _create_chat(self, client, token: str = None, title: str = "Test Chat"):
        headers = {}
        if token:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
        return client.post("/chats", json={
            "agent_id": "test_agent",
            "title": title,
            "mode": "chat",
        }, headers=headers if headers else None)

    def test_user_can_only_see_own_chats(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        # 创建两个用户
        _register(client, "user1", "password123")
        _register(client, "user2", "password123")
        token1 = _login(client, "user1", "password123").json()["token"]
        token2 = _login(client, "user2", "password123").json()["token"]

        # user1 创建会话
        self._create_chat(client, token1, "User1 Chat")
        # user2 创建会话
        self._create_chat(client, token2, "User2 Chat")

        # user1 只能看到自己的
        r1 = client.get("/chats", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token1}"})
        assert r1.status_code == 200
        chats1 = r1.json()
        assert len(chats1) == 1
        assert chats1[0]["title"] == "User1 Chat"

        # user2 只能看到自己的
        r2 = client.get("/chats", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token2}"})
        assert r2.status_code == 200
        chats2 = r2.json()
        assert len(chats2) == 1
        assert chats2[0]["title"] == "User2 Chat"

    def test_admin_can_see_all_chats(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        # 创建 admin 和普通用户
        _register(client, "admin1", "password123", role="admin")
        _register(client, "user3", "password123")
        admin_token = _login(client, "admin1", "password123").json()["token"]
        user_token = _login(client, "user3", "password123").json()["token"]

        # 两个用户各创建一个会话
        self._create_chat(client, admin_token, "Admin Chat")
        self._create_chat(client, user_token, "User Chat")

        # admin 可以看到全部
        r = client.get("/chats", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert len(r.json()) == 2

    def test_no_token_sees_all_chats_backward_compatible(self, client):
        """不带 token 访问列表时行为不变（向后兼容）。"""
        self._create_agent(client)
        self._create_chat(client, title="Old Chat")

        r = client.get("/chats")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert len(r.json()) == 1

    def test_user_cannot_access_others_chat_messages(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner", "password123")
        _register(client, "intruder", "password123")
        owner_token = _login(client, "owner", "password123").json()["token"]
        intruder_token = _login(client, "intruder", "password123").json()["token"]

        # owner 创建会话
        chat = self._create_chat(client, owner_token, "Private Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        # intruder 尝试访问
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {intruder_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

    def test_user_can_access_own_chat_messages(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner2", "password123")
        token = _login(client, "owner2", "password123").json()["token"]

        chat = self._create_chat(client, token, "My Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert r.json() == []

    def test_user_cannot_send_to_others_chat(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner3", "password123")
        _register(client, "hacker", "password123")
        owner_token = _login(client, "owner3", "password123").json()["token"]
        hacker_token = _login(client, "hacker", "password123").json()["token"]

        chat = self._create_chat(client, owner_token, "Protected Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        r = client.post(f"/chats/{chat_id}/send", json={"content": "hello"},
                        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {hacker_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

    def test_chat_without_user_id_is_admin_owned(self, client):
        """旧会话（user_id 为空）视为管理员所有。"""
        self._create_agent(client)

        # 不带 token 创建会话（旧行为）
        chat = self._create_chat(client, title="Legacy Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        # admin 可以访问
        _register(client, "admin2", "password123", role="admin")
        admin_token = _login(client, "admin2", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200

        # 普通用户不能访问
        _register(client, "normal", "password123")
        user_token = _login(client, "normal", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {user_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

"""对话服务：创建会话、发送消息（组装上下文 + 意图 + 简版回复 + 记忆提取）。"""
import json
from typing import Optional

from app.models import Agent, Chat, Message
from app.database import Session
from app.core import intent as intent_mod, tokens, context as context_mod, memory as memory_mod


class ChatError(Exception):
    pass


def create_chat(db: Session, agent_id: str, title: str, model: str,
                mode: str, project_path: str, personality_level: Optional[int]) -> Chat:
    agent = db.query(Agent).filter(Agent.agent_id == agent_id).first()
    if agent is None:
        raise ChatError(f"Agent 不存在: {agent_id}")
    chat = Chat(
        agent_id=agent_id, title=title, model=model, mode=mode,
        project_path=project_path,
        personality_level=personality_level if personality_level is not None else agent.personality_level,
    )
    db.add(chat)
    db.flush()
    return chat


def _tally_messages(db: Session, chat_id: int) -> list:
    return (
        db.query(Message)
        .filter(Message.chat_id == chat_id)
        .order_by(Message.id)
        .all()
    )


def _load_agent(db: Session, agent_id: str) -> Optional[Agent]:
    return db.query(Agent).filter(Agent.agent_id == agent_id).first()


def _load_memories(db: Session, agent_id: str, limit: int = 10) -> list:
    return memory_mod.query_memories(db, scope="agent", agent_id=agent_id, limit=limit)


def _build_context_system(db: Session, chat: Chat) -> list:
    agent = _load_agent(db, chat.agent_id)
    identity = agent.identity if agent else ""
    caps = _json_caps(agent.capabilities) if agent else []
    memories = _load_memories(db, chat.agent_id)
    mem_items = [{"scope": "agent", "content": m.content} for m in memories]
    mem_text = context_mod.build_memory_text(mem_items)
    persona_text = context_mod.assemble_personality_text(chat.personality_level or 0)
    system = context_mod.build_system_prompt(
        identity=identity, capabilities=caps,
        memory_text=mem_text, personality_text=persona_text,
    )
    return [{"role": "system", "content": system}]


def send_message(db: Session, chat_id: int, content: str) -> tuple:
    """处理一条用户消息，返回 (user_msg, ai_msg, meta)。"""
    chat = db.query(Chat).filter(Chat.id == chat_id).first()
    if chat is None:
        raise ChatError("会话不存在")

    user_msg = Message(chat_id=chat_id, role="user", content=content,
                       tokens=tokens.count_tokens(content))
    db.add(user_msg)
    db.flush()

    analyzer = intent_mod.IntentAnalyzer()
    intent_result = analyzer.analyze(content)
    history = _tally_messages(db, chat_id)
    sys_messages = _build_context_system(db, chat)

    max_tokens = 8000
    history_dicts = [{"role": m.role, "content": m.content} for m in history]
    sys_est = tokens.estimate_messages_tokens(sys_messages)
    full = sys_messages + history_dicts
    total_est = tokens.estimate_messages_tokens(full)

    truncated = False
    context_messages = history_dicts
    if total_est > max_tokens:
        budget = max_tokens - sys_est
        context_messages = context_mod.truncate_history(history_dicts, budget)
        truncated = True

    reply = _template_reply(content, intent_result["intent"])
    ai_msg = Message(chat_id=chat_id, role="assistant", content=reply,
                     tokens=tokens.count_tokens(reply))
    db.add(ai_msg)
    db.flush()

    memory_added = 0
    try:
        highlights = memory_mod.extract_highlights(content, reply)
        for h in highlights:
            memory_mod.add_memory(db, "agent", h, agent_id=chat.agent_id, source="auto")
            memory_added += 1
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — 记忆失败不应阻断对话
        pass

    db.flush()
    meta = {
        "intent": intent_result["intent"],
        "tokens_per_context": tokens.estimate_messages_tokens(full),
        "context_messages": len(context_messages),
        "truncated": truncated,
        "memory_added": memory_added,
    }
    return user_msg, ai_msg, meta


def _template_reply(content: str, intent: str) -> str:
    if intent in ("file_operation", "project_debug", "memory_operation"):
        return f"[任务建议] 检测到 {intent} 意图，需要工具配合完成。消息: {content[:50]}"
    return f"收到: {content[:80]}"


def _json_caps(raw: str) -> list:
    try:
        return json.loads(raw or "[]")
    except ValueError:
        return []

        "capabilities": ["coding", "debug"],

    client.post("/agents", json={
        "agent_id": "helper",
        "name": "助手",
        "identity": "你是乐于助人的助手",
        "capabilities": [],
        "personality_level": 0,
    })
    chat = client.post("/chats", json={"agent_id": "helper", "title": "测试会话", "mode": "chat"})
    assert chat.status_code == 200
    chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

    r = client.post(f"/chats/{chat_id}/send", json={"content": "帮我看看这个文件的内容"})

    body = r.json()
    assert body["user_message"]["content"] == "帮我看看这个文件的内容"

        "identity": "",

        "personality_level": 0,
    })
    chat = client.post("/chats", json={"agent_id": "memtest"}).json()

    # 长消息触发自动记忆提取
    long_msg = "这是一条超过二十个字的用户消息，关于项目架构的重要决定" * 2
    client.post(f"/chats/{chat['id']}/send", json={"content": long_msg})

"""对话服务：创建会话、发送消息（组装上下文 + 意图 + 简版回复 + 记忆提取）。"""
import json
from typing import Optional

from app.models import Agent, Chat, Message
from app.database import Session
from app.core import intent as intent_mod, tokens, context as context_mod, memory as memory_mod


class ChatError(Exception):
    pass


def create_chat(
    db: Session,
    agent_id: str,
    title: str,
    model: str,
    mode: str,
    project_path: str,
    personality_level: Optional[int],
    user_id: Optional[int] = None,
) -> Chat:
    agent = db.query(Agent).filter(Agent.agent_id == agent_id).first()
    if agent is None:
        raise ChatError(f"Agent 不存在: {agent_id}")
    chat = Chat(
        agent_id=agent_id, title=title, model=model, mode=mode,
        project_path=project_path,
        personality_level=personality_level if personality_level is not None else agent.personality_level,
        user_id=user_id,
    )
    db.add(chat)
    db.flush()
    return chat


def _tally_messages(db: Session, chat_id: int) -> list:
    return (
        db.query(Message)
        .filter(Message.chat_id == chat_id)
        .order_by(Message.id)
        .all()
    )


def _load_agent(db: Session, agent_id: str) -> Optional[Agent]:
    return db.query(Agent).filter(Agent.agent_id == agent_id).first()


def _load_memories(db: Session, agent_id: str, limit: int = 10) -> list:
    return memory_mod.query_memories(db, scope="agent", agent_id=agent_id, limit=limit)


def _build_context_system(db: Session, chat: Chat) -> list:
    agent = _load_agent(db, chat.agent_id)
    identity = agent.identity if agent else ""
    caps = _json_caps(agent.capabilities) if agent else []
    memories = _load_memories(db, chat.agent_id)
    mem_items = [{"scope": "agent", "content": m.content} for m in memories]
    mem_text = context_mod.build_memory_text(mem_items)
    persona_text = context_mod.assemble_personality_text(chat.personality_level or 0)
    system = context_mod.build_system_prompt(
        identity=identity, capabilities=caps,
        memory_text=mem_text, personality_text=persona_text,
    )
    return [{"role": "system", "content": system}]


def send_message(db: Session, chat_id: int, content: str) -> tuple:
    """处理一条用户消息，返回 (user_msg, ai_msg, meta)。"""
    chat = db.query(Chat).filter(Chat.id == chat_id).first()
    if chat is None:
        raise ChatError("会话不存在")

    user_msg = Message(chat_id=chat_id, role="user", content=content,
                       tokens=tokens.count_tokens(content))
    db.add(user_msg)
    db.flush()

    analyzer = intent_mod.IntentAnalyzer()
    intent_result = analyzer.analyze(content)
    history = _tally_messages(db, chat_id)
    sys_messages = _build_context_system(db, chat)

    max_tokens = 8000
    history_dicts = [{"role": m.role, "content": m.content} for m in history]
    sys_est = tokens.estimate_messages_tokens(sys_messages)
    full = sys_messages + history_dicts
    total_est = tokens.estimate_messages_tokens(full)

    truncated = False
    context_messages = history_dicts
    if total_est > max_tokens:
        budget = max_tokens - sys_est
        context_messages = context_mod.truncate_history(history_dicts, budget)
        truncated = True

    reply = _template_reply(content, intent_result["intent"])
    ai_msg = Message(chat_id=chat_id, role="assistant", content=reply,
                     tokens=tokens.count_tokens(reply))
    db.add(ai_msg)
    db.flush()

    memory_added = 0
    try:
        highlights = memory_mod.extract_highlights(content, reply)
        for h in highlights:
            memory_mod.add_memory(db, "agent", h, agent_id=chat.agent_id, source="auto")
            memory_added += 1
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — 记忆失败不应阻断对话
        pass

    db.flush()
    meta = {
        "intent": intent_result["intent"],
        "tokens_per_context": tokens.estimate_messages_tokens(full),
        "context_messages": len(context_messages),
        "truncated": truncated,
        "memory_added": memory_added,
    }
    return user_msg, ai_msg, meta


def _template_reply(content: str, intent: str) -> str:
    if intent in ("file_operation", "project_debug", "memory_operation"):
        return f"[任务建议] 检测到 {intent} 意图，需要工具配合完成。消息: {content[:50]}"
    return f"收到: {content[:80]}"


def _json_caps(raw: str) -> list:
    try:
        return json.loads(raw or "[]")
    except ValueError:
        return []

"""用户系统与权限控制测试。"""
import sys
import os

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import app.database as database
from app.models import Base, User
from app.core.auth import hash_password, store_token, _token_store


@pytest.fixture()
def client():
    database.set_database_url("sqlite://")
    engine = database.get_engine()
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    from app.main import app
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        yield c
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
    _token_store.clear()


def _register(client, username: str, password: str, role: str = "user"):
    return client.post("/api/users/register", json={
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "role": role,
    })


def _login(client, username: str, password: str):
    return client.post("/api/users/login", json={
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
    })


# ── 注册测试 ──

class TestRegister:
    def test_register_success(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "alice", "password123")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        data = r.json()
        assert data["username"] == "alice"
        assert data["role"] == "user"
        assert "id" in data

    def test_register_admin(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "admin", "password123", role="admin")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert r.json()["role"] == "admin"

    def test_register_duplicate_username(self, client):
        _register(client, "bob", "password123")
        r = _register(client, "bob", "password456")
        assert r.status_code == 400
        assert "已存在" in r.json()["detail"]

    def test_register_invalid_role(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "eve", "password123", role="superadmin")
        assert r.status_code == 400

    def test_register_short_username(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "ab", "password123")
        assert r.status_code == 422

    def test_register_short_password(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "user1", "12345")
        assert r.status_code == 422


# ── 登录测试 ──

class TestLogin:
    def test_login_success(self, client):
        _register(client, "carol", "password123")
        r = _login(client, "carol", "password123")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        data = r.json()
        assert "token" in data
        assert data["user"]["username"] == "carol"

    def test_login_wrong_password(self, client):
        _register(client, "dave", "password123")
        r = _login(client, "dave", "wrongpass")
        assert r.status_code == 401

    def test_login_nonexistent_user(self, client):
        r = _login(client, "ghost", "password123")
        assert r.status_code == 401


# ── /me 测试 ──

class TestMe:
    def test_me_with_valid_token(self, client):
        _register(client, "frank", "password123")
        token = _login(client, "frank", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get("/api/users/me", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert r.json()["username"] == "frank"

    def test_me_without_token(self, client):
        r = client.get("/api/users/me")
        assert r.status_code == 403

    def test_me_with_invalid_token(self, client):
        r = client.get("/api/users/me", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer invalid_token"})
        assert r.status_code == 401


# ── 权限控制测试 ──

class TestChatPermissions:
    def _create_agent(self, client):
        client.post("/agents", json={
            "agent_id": "test_agent",
            "name": "测试Agent",
            "identity": "",
            "capabilities": [],
            "personality_level": 0,
        })

    def _create_chat(self, client, token: str = None, title: str = "Test Chat"):
        headers = {}
        if token:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
        return client.post("/chats", json={
            "agent_id": "test_agent",
            "title": title,
            "mode": "chat",
        }, headers=headers if headers else None)

    def test_user_can_only_see_own_chats(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        # 创建两个用户
        _register(client, "user1", "password123")
        _register(client, "user2", "password123")
        token1 = _login(client, "user1", "password123").json()["token"]
        token2 = _login(client, "user2", "password123").json()["token"]

        # user1 创建会话
        self._create_chat(client, token1, "User1 Chat")
        # user2 创建会话
        self._create_chat(client, token2, "User2 Chat")

        # user1 只能看到自己的
        r1 = client.get("/chats", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token1}"})
        assert r1.status_code == 200
        chats1 = r1.json()
        assert len(chats1) == 1
        assert chats1[0]["title"] == "User1 Chat"

        # user2 只能看到自己的
        r2 = client.get("/chats", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token2}"})
        assert r2.status_code == 200
        chats2 = r2.json()
        assert len(chats2) == 1
        assert chats2[0]["title"] == "User2 Chat"

    def test_admin_can_see_all_chats(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        # 创建 admin 和普通用户
        _register(client, "admin1", "password123", role="admin")
        _register(client, "user3", "password123")
        admin_token = _login(client, "admin1", "password123").json()["token"]
        user_token = _login(client, "user3", "password123").json()["token"]

        # 两个用户各创建一个会话
        self._create_chat(client, admin_token, "Admin Chat")
        self._create_chat(client, user_token, "User Chat")

        # admin 可以看到全部
        r = client.get("/chats", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert len(r.json()) == 2

    def test_no_token_sees_all_chats_backward_compatible(self, client):
        """不带 token 访问列表时行为不变（向后兼容）。"""
        self._create_agent(client)
        self._create_chat(client, title="Old Chat")

        r = client.get("/chats")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert len(r.json()) == 1

    def test_user_cannot_access_others_chat_messages(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner", "password123")
        _register(client, "intruder", "password123")
        owner_token = _login(client, "owner", "password123").json()["token"]
        intruder_token = _login(client, "intruder", "password123").json()["token"]

        # owner 创建会话
        chat = self._create_chat(client, owner_token, "Private Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        # intruder 尝试访问
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {intruder_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

    def test_user_can_access_own_chat_messages(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner2", "password123")
        token = _login(client, "owner2", "password123").json()["token"]

        chat = self._create_chat(client, token, "My Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert r.json() == []

    def test_user_cannot_send_to_others_chat(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner3", "password123")
        _register(client, "hacker", "password123")
        owner_token = _login(client, "owner3", "password123").json()["token"]
        hacker_token = _login(client, "hacker", "password123").json()["token"]

        chat = self._create_chat(client, owner_token, "Protected Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        r = client.post(f"/chats/{chat_id}/send", json={"content": "hello"},
                        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {hacker_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

    def test_chat_without_user_id_is_admin_owned(self, client):
        """旧会话（user_id 为空）视为管理员所有。"""
        self._create_agent(client)

        # 不带 token 创建会话（旧行为）
        chat = self._create_chat(client, title="Legacy Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        # admin 可以访问
        _register(client, "admin2", "password123", role="admin")
        admin_token = _login(client, "admin2", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200

        # 普通用户不能访问
        _register(client, "normal", "password123")
        user_token = _login(client, "normal", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {user_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

import sys
import os

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import app.database as database
from app.models import Base, User
from app.core.auth import hash_password, store_token, _token_store


@pytest.fixture()
def client():
    database.set_database_url("sqlite://")
    engine = database.get_engine()
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    from app.main import app
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        yield c
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
    _token_store.clear()


def _register(client, username: str, password: str, role: str = "user"):
    return client.post("/api/users/register", json={
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "role": role,
    })


def _login(client, username: str, password: str):
    return client.post("/api/users/login", json={
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
    })


# ── 注册测试 ──

class TestRegister:
    def test_register_success(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "alice", "password123")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        data = r.json()
        assert data["username"] == "alice"
        assert data["role"] == "user"
        assert "id" in data

    def test_register_admin(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "admin", "password123", role="admin")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert r.json()["role"] == "admin"

    def test_register_duplicate_username(self, client):
        _register(client, "bob", "password123")
        r = _register(client, "bob", "password456")
        assert r.status_code == 400
        assert "已存在" in r.json()["detail"]

    def test_register_invalid_role(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "eve", "password123", role="superadmin")
        assert r.status_code == 400

    def test_register_short_username(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "ab", "password123")
        assert r.status_code == 422

    def test_register_short_password(self, client):
        r = _register(client, "user1", "12345")
        assert r.status_code == 422


# ── 登录测试 ──

class TestLogin:
    def test_login_success(self, client):
        _register(client, "carol", "password123")
        r = _login(client, "carol", "password123")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        data = r.json()
        assert "token" in data
        assert data["user"]["username"] == "carol"

    def test_login_wrong_password(self, client):
        _register(client, "dave", "password123")
        r = _login(client, "dave", "wrongpass")
        assert r.status_code == 401

    def test_login_nonexistent_user(self, client):
        r = _login(client, "ghost", "password123")
        assert r.status_code == 401

        _register(client, "frank", "password123")
        token = _login(client, "frank", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get("/api/users/me", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert r.json()["username"] == "frank"

    def test_me_without_token(self, client):
        # 无 token 时返回 401
        r = client.get("/api/users/me")
        assert r.status_code == 401

    def test_me_with_invalid_token(self, client):
        r = client.get("/api/users/me", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer invalid_token"})
        assert r.status_code == 401


# ── 权限控制测试 ──

class TestChatPermissions:
    def _create_agent(self, client):
        client.post("/agents", json={
            "agent_id": "test_agent",
            "name": "测试Agent",
            "identity": "",
            "capabilities": [],
            "personality_level": 0,
        })

    def _create_chat(self, client, token: str = None, title: str = "Test Chat"):
        headers = {}
        if token:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
        return client.post("/chats", json={
            "agent_id": "test_agent",
            "title": title,
            "mode": "chat",
        }, headers=headers if headers else None)

    def test_user_can_only_see_own_chats(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        # 创建两个用户
        _register(client, "user1", "password123")
        _register(client, "user2", "password123")
        token1 = _login(client, "user1", "password123").json()["token"]
        token2 = _login(client, "user2", "password123").json()["token"]

        # user1 创建会话
        self._create_chat(client, token1, "User1 Chat")
        # user2 创建会话
        self._create_chat(client, token2, "User2 Chat")

        # user1 只能看到自己的
        r1 = client.get("/chats", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token1}"})
        assert r1.status_code == 200
        chats1 = r1.json()
        assert len(chats1) == 1
        assert chats1[0]["title"] == "User1 Chat"

        # user2 只能看到自己的
        r2 = client.get("/chats", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token2}"})
        assert r2.status_code == 200
        chats2 = r2.json()
        assert len(chats2) == 1
        assert chats2[0]["title"] == "User2 Chat"

    def test_admin_can_see_all_chats(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        # 创建 admin 和普通用户
        _register(client, "admin1", "password123", role="admin")
        _register(client, "user3", "password123")
        admin_token = _login(client, "admin1", "password123").json()["token"]
        user_token = _login(client, "user3", "password123").json()["token"]

        # 两个用户各创建一个会话
        self._create_chat(client, admin_token, "Admin Chat")
        self._create_chat(client, user_token, "User Chat")

        # admin 可以看到全部
        r = client.get("/chats", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert len(r.json()) == 2

    def test_no_token_sees_all_chats_backward_compatible(self, client):
        """不带 token 访问列表时行为不变（向后兼容）。"""
        self._create_agent(client)
        self._create_chat(client, title="Old Chat")

        r = client.get("/chats")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert len(r.json()) == 1

    def test_user_cannot_access_others_chat_messages(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner", "password123")
        _register(client, "intruder", "password123")
        owner_token = _login(client, "owner", "password123").json()["token"]
        intruder_token = _login(client, "intruder", "password123").json()["token"]

        # owner 创建会话
        chat = self._create_chat(client, owner_token, "Private Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        # intruder 尝试访问
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {intruder_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

    def test_user_can_access_own_chat_messages(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner2", "password123")
        token = _login(client, "owner2", "password123").json()["token"]

        chat = self._create_chat(client, token, "My Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert r.json() == []

    def test_user_cannot_send_to_others_chat(self, client):
        self._create_agent(client)

        _register(client, "owner3", "password123")
        _register(client, "hacker", "password123")
        owner_token = _login(client, "owner3", "password123").json()["token"]
        hacker_token = _login(client, "hacker", "password123").json()["token"]

        chat = self._create_chat(client, owner_token, "Protected Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        r = client.post(f"/chats/{chat_id}/send", json={"content": "hello"},
                        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {hacker_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403

    def test_chat_without_user_id_is_admin_owned(self, client):
        """旧会话（user_id 为空）视为管理员所有。"""
        self._create_agent(client)

        # 不带 token 创建会话（旧行为）
        chat = self._create_chat(client, title="Legacy Chat")
        chat_id = chat.json()["id"]

        # admin 可以访问
        _register(client, "admin2", "password123", role="admin")
        admin_token = _login(client, "admin2", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 200

        # 普通用户不能访问
        _register(client, "normal", "password123")
        user_token = _login(client, "normal", "password123").json()["token"]
        r = client.get(f"/chats/{chat_id}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {user_token}"})
        assert r.status_code == 403
